attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DNS resolver for the shared private network (10.100.206.0/24): PowerDNS Recursor listens on node1's LAN address (10.100.206.10), answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.206.11) via a static-host-mapping (exported through export-etc-hosts=yes), and forwards all other queries to the upstream resolver at the platform gateway (10.100.206.1). Configured node2 and node3 (RHEL 9, via NetworkManager) to use node1 (10.100.206.10) as their sole DNS server. Verified end-to-end resolution of both inventory.internal and external names from all three nodes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot identities and full post-restart recovery of DNS configuration, service state, and resolution behavior.
